definitionZh: :-moz-first-node CSS伪类是一个Mozilla扩展,代表着某些其他元素的第一个儿童节点的任何元素. 它不同于: 第一子,因为它与其面前的(非白空间)文本不匹配第一子元素.
sourceDefinition: The :-moz-first-node CSS pseudo-class is a Mozilla extension that represents any element that is the first child node of some other element. It differs from :first-child because it does not match a first-child element with (non-whitespace) text before it.
